entries.title: Psalms 55:1
segments: ¶<<To the Chief Musician. With stringed instruments. A Contemplation of David.>> Give ear to my prayer, O God, And do not hide Yourself from my supplication.

entries.title: Psalms 55:2
segments: Attend to me, and hear me; I am restless in my complaint, and moan noisily,

entries.title: Psalms 55:3
segments: Because of the voice of the enemy, Because of the oppression of the wicked; For they bring down trouble upon me, And in wrath they hate me.

entries.title: Psalms 55:4
segments: My heart is severely pained within me, And the terrors of death have fallen upon me.

entries.title: Psalms 55:5
segments: Fearfulness and trembling have come upon me, And horror has overwhelmed me.

entries.title: Psalms 55:6
segments: So I said, "Oh, that I had wings like a dove! I would fly away and be at rest.

entries.title: Psalms 55:7
segments: Indeed, I would wander far off, [And] remain in the wilderness. Selah

entries.title: Psalms 55:8
segments: I would hasten my escape From the windy storm [and] tempest."

entries.title: Psalms 55:9
segments: ¶Destroy, O Lord, [and] divide their tongues, For I have seen violence and strife in the city.

entries.title: Psalms 55:10
segments: Day and night they go around it on its walls; Iniquity and trouble [are] also in the midst of it.

entries.title: Psalms 55:11
segments: Destruction [is] in its midst; Oppression and deceit do not depart from its streets.

entries.title: Psalms 55:12
segments: For [it is] not an enemy [who] reproaches me; Then I could bear [it]. Nor [is it] one [who] hates me who has exalted [himself] against me; Then I could hide from him.

entries.title: Psalms 55:13
segments: But [it was] you, a man my equal, My companion and my acquaintance.

entries.title: Psalms 55:14
segments: We took sweet counsel together, [And] walked to the house of God in the throng.

entries.title: Psalms 55:15
segments: Let death seize them; Let them go down alive into hell, For wickedness [is] in their dwellings [and] among them.

entries.title: Psalms 55:16
segments: ¶As for me, I will call upon God, And the LORD shall save me.

entries.title: Psalms 55:17
segments: Evening and morning and at noon I will pray, and cry aloud, And He shall hear my voice.

entries.title: Psalms 55:18
segments: He has redeemed my soul in peace from the battle [that was] against me, For there were many against me.

entries.title: Psalms 55:19
segments: God will hear, and afflict them, Even He who abides from of old. Selah Because they do not change, Therefore they do not fear God.

entries.title: Psalms 55:20
segments: He has put forth his hands against those who were at peace with him; He has broken his covenant.

entries.title: Psalms 55:21
segments: [The words] of his mouth were smoother than butter, But war [was] in his heart; His words were softer than oil, Yet they [were] drawn swords.

entries.title: Psalms 55:22
segments: Cast your burden on the LORD, And He shall sustain you; He shall never permit the righteous to be moved.

entries.title: Psalms 55:23
segments: But You, O God, shall bring them down to the pit of destruction; Bloodthirsty and deceitful men shall not live out half their days; But I will trust in You.
